headline: Analysis: Everyone expects the Fed to hold rates in October. Kevin Warsh could surprise us all
detail: This is a major market driver. Any surprise from the Fed on interest rates would directly impact growth stocks and tech names, especially given your margin exposure. Higher rates make borrowing more expensive and can depress valuations.
rec: Be prepared for potential volatility around the next Fed announcement. Review your stops, especially on leveraged positions, as rate surprises can cause sharp moves.

headline: Elon Musk may have just taken a major step toward consolidating his empire
